Use the `mistral-tokenizer` package. Install it (`pip install mistral-tokenizer`), then:

```python
from mistral_tokenizer import MistralTokenizer
tokenizer = MistralTokenizer()
token_count = len(tokenizer.encode("Your prompt here"))
```

[Count tokens locally](https://docs.mistral.ai/guides/tokenization#count-tokens-locally)
